summary: Cycle-7 testing of the 3 new items: manual UPI checkout, secured admin login, dark/light theme toggle. NEW suite /app/backend/tests/test_upi_adminlogin.py (15 tests) — 15/15 pass: UPI claim->admin confirm->paid+status processing+invoice, confirm idempotency (invoice not regenerated), 400 on claiming a paid order, 404 unknown order, 401 unauthenticated, 403 for distributor calling admin confirm, cross-user claim blocked (404), Stripe checkout regression (checkout_url + session_id + status endpoint) and Stripe 400 on already-paid order; admin-login success (super_admin token works on /api/admin/dashboard), wrong passcode 401, missing passcode 401/422, distributor+correct passcode 401 (role gate), 5x401 then 429 lockout on a throwaway identifier (correct passcode still 429 while locked). Full regression re-run: backend_test.py + test_health_dashboard.py + test_otp_auth.py = 77 passed, 1 skipped (1 pre-existing brittle count assertion fixed test-side). FRONTEND: /login has NO demo buttons (demo-distributor-btn / demo-admin-btn count 0, no 'Demo Admin'/'Admin Login' text) and normal login redirects distributor to /app/dashboard; /admin-secure-login renders with all 4 testids, wrong passcode stays on page with error (401 from API), correct email+password+passcode redirects to /admin; admin Orders showed the claimed ORD000023 with upi-confirm-ORD000023, clicking it turned the row to paid/processing/INV000013 and the button disappeared ('Payment confirmed & activated' toast); theme-toggle present in both distributor and admin headers, flips html.dark, persists via localStorage anj_theme across reload and toggles back. ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: the UPI QR panel is never shown to the user (Checkout.js redirects to /app/products the moment the cart is cleared), so the customer never sees the PhonePe QR / amount even though the order is created and marked 'claimed' server-side.

minor.issue: No admin-side rejection/reversal path: an order can only be confirmed, never rejected back to 'pending' if the UPI reference is bogus. Distributor's 'claimed' order also has no expiry, so a false claim blocks the Stripe path only partially (checkout still allowed) but permanently shows 'claimed' to admins.

reference is accepted as a free-form string with no length/format validation and no uniqueness check, so the same UTR can be submitted on many orders. Consider max_length + duplicate-reference warning for the admin.

Lockout key is 'admin:{email}' only (no IP component), so anyone can lock a known admin email out for 15 minutes by sending 5 bad passcodes (account-DoS). Combine email+IP or add a CAPTCHA/backoff instead of a hard block.

PRE-EXISTING (iteration_6): the plain login lockout is keyed on request.client.host (ingress proxy IP) and has no time window. /auth/admin-login correctly implements the 15-min window; the same fix has not been backported to /auth/login.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: UPI QR panel never renders. Line 30 `if (items.length === 0) { navigate('/app/products'); return null; }` executes BEFORE the `if (showQr)` block (line 58). upiPay() calls clear() then setShowQr(order), so on the next render the cart is empty and the user is bounced to /app/products — never sees the PhonePe QR, the amount or the 'admin will verify' instruction. Reproduced live: clicking upi-pay-btn created ORD000023 (payment_status='claimed' confirmed via API) but landed the user on /app/products with React warning 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Checkout)'. Fix: move the `if (showQr) return (...)` block above the empty-cart guard, and move the redirect into a useEffect (navigate during render is also a React violation).

No user-visible feedback that the order was created after upiPay() (no toast, no order number) because of the redirect above — a user will very likely re-add the kit and create duplicate claimed orders.

GST/total shown in the summary are computed client-side with a hardcoded 5% (`Math.round(subtotal*0.05)`) instead of the admin `gst_percent` setting used by the backend — will silently mismatch the invoice if the setting is changed.

integration_issues.issue: Backend claim succeeds (order -> 'claimed') but the frontend swallows the result by redirecting; the QR step of the flow is effectively unusable in the UI.
None — worked end-to-end (ORD000023 claimed -> paid, INV000013, button removed after refresh).

issues: Primary CTAs (btn-grad / bg-forest) are barely legible in dark mode: 'Add to Cart', 'Request Withdrawal', 'Shopping Cart' render as dark-green text on a dark-green fill. index.css only overrides .dark .text-forest/.bg-white/.bg-brand-50 etc., and the .text-forest override (#57b487) also hits text INSIDE dark-green buttons. Add explicit .dark button overrides or scope the text-forest override.

'Your distributor account is active.' banner keeps its light background rgba(234,245,237,0.5) with green text = contrast ratio 2.27:1 (fails WCAG AA). The bg-brand-50/50 variant is not in the .dark override list.
Header 'GREEN ID' status badge is illegible (dark green on dark green).
Wallet debit amounts '-Rs500' = 2.94:1 on #16211c (below 4.5:1) — lighten the red for dark mode.

'Activation' badge on the starter-kit image and the category pills lose contrast; product image tiles keep white/light backgrounds so the grid looks patchy in dark mode (acceptable for photos, but the badge needs fixing).
Input fields (bg-white/10 on bg-forest) look almost invisible/empty at a glance and the placeholder (white/40) is very low contrast; add a visible border/darker field background.
No theme-toggle on this page and no toggle on public /login or Landing — theme can only be changed after login (spec-compliant but inconsistent).

action_items: CRITICAL: In Checkout.js move the `if (showQr) return (...)` block ABOVE the `items.length === 0` guard, and convert that guard to a useEffect-based redirect (it currently calls navigate() during render). Re-verify upi-qr-panel / phonepe-qr / upi-done-btn appear after clicking upi-pay-btn.
Add a toast + order number on successful UPI claim so users don't create duplicate claimed orders.
Fix dark-mode contrast: dark overrides for btn-grad/bg-forest button text, bg-brand-50/50 success banner, StatusBadge (GREEN ID), and the debit red.
Improve /admin-secure-login field visibility (border / darker field background, higher-contrast placeholder).
Backend: add an admin 'reject UPI claim' action (claimed -> pending) and validate/limit the length of upi reference.
Backend: consider email+IP keying for the admin-login lockout to avoid trivial admin account lock-out DoS; backport the 15-min window from admin-login to /api/auth/login.
Use the server gst_percent setting in the Checkout summary instead of a hardcoded 5%.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.js:30 — navigate() called during render and placed before the showQr branch: this both violates React render purity (observed console warning) and makes the entire QR step dead code.

shop_routes.upi_confirm — idempotency is solid: the payment_status=='paid' short-circuit plus the session_id='manual_{order_id}' uniqueness means _process_paid_order can't double-issue an invoice or a commission (verified: repeat confirm kept INV000012).

upi_claim correctly re-checks order ownership (order['user_id'] != user['id'] -> 404) and rejects already-paid orders; admin confirm is behind require_admin (403 for distributor) — both verified by tests.

auth_routes.admin_login uses hmac.compare_digest + role gate + a real 15-minute lockout window; ADMIN_PASSCODE comes from env. Note the missing bool guard would be a bypass if ADMIN_PASSCODE were empty — it is handled (`bool(ADMIN_PASSCODE) and ...`).

Dark mode is implemented with ~20 `.dark .<utility> { !important }` overrides in index.css rather than dark: variants. This is fragile — every new utility class used in a page must be added manually, which is exactly why the success banner and CTA buttons broke.

rca_of_the_issue: Manual-UPI QR never displayed: Checkout.js is a single component that (a) guards an empty cart with an inline `navigate('/app/products'); return null;` at line 30 and (b) renders the QR panel from `showQr` state at line 58. upiPay() calls `clear()` (emptying the cart) immediately before `setShowQr(order)`, so on the very next render the line-30 guard fires first and navigates away before the line-58 branch is ever reached. The backend side is unaffected — the order is created and set to payment_status='claimed' (verified: ORD000023) — but the user is silently returned to the product list with no QR, no amount and no confirmation, which will drive duplicate claimed orders. Fix = reorder the branches (showQr first) and move the empty-cart redirect into a useEffect.
